# EdNet Learn Gurukul · Interactive Sanskrit & Vedic Studies

> EdNet Learn Gurukul is a comprehensive online Sanskrit learning platform from beginner to advanced scholarly fluency. It features graded NCERT/CBSE textbooks, an Ashtadhyayi Paninian grammar engine with Dhatupatha, 16 Vedic mathematics sutras, interactive science laboratories, and classical philosophical treatises.

## Core Modules & Learning Portals

- [Sanskrit Thinking Course (संस्कृत-चिन्तनम्)](https://ednetlearn.in/course): 28 structured lessons exploring Sanskrit as an integrated computational and contemplative system: Sound as Input, Rules as Processing, Meaning as Output.
- [Interactive Graded Reader (दीपकम & शारदा)](https://ednetlearn.in/reader): Graded readers for NCERT Class 7 (Deepakam 7), Class 8 (Deepakam 8), and Class 9 (Sharada 9) with word-by-word sandhi breakdown, grammatical parsing, audio recitation, and English translations.
- [Varṇamālā & Syllable Studio (वर्णमाला)](https://ednetlearn.in/barakhadi): Interactive audio alphabet, 400+ barakhadi consonant-vowel combinations, conjunct consonants (saṃyuktākṣara), and stroke order writing drills.
- [Pāṇinian Grammar & Dhātupāṭha (पाणिनीय-व्याकरणम्)](https://ednetlearn.in/grammar): Interactive Aṣṭādhyāyī sūtra engine, 2,000+ roots Dhātupāṭha with Gaṇas and Padas, Subanta noun declensions across 7 Vibhaktis, and Tiṅanta verb conjugations across 5 Lakāras.
- [Vedic Mathematics & Līlāvatī (वैदिक-गणितम्)](https://ednetlearn.in/vedic-maths): 16 Vedic mathematical sutras, rapid mental arithmetic algorithms, Bhāskarācārya's Līlāvatī poetic math studio, and Kaṭapayādi cipher tools.
- [Vijñāna Science Laboratory (विज्ञान-प्रयोगशाला)](https://ednetlearn.in/vignana-lab): 10 interactive physics, astronomy, botany, metallurgy, and rocketry simulations linked directly to ancient Sanskrit scientific treatises (Vaiśeṣika, Āryabhaṭīya, Suśruta, Rasaratnākara) (aliased at /science-lab).
- [CBSE Sanskrit Examination Guide (सीबीएसई-मार्गदर्शिका)](https://ednetlearn.in/cbse-sanskrit-guide): Complete syllabus, blueprints, question patterns, sandhi/samasa rules, and sample papers for school students.
- [Sanskrit Word Puzzles & Jodo (शब्द-पहेलिकाः)](https://ednetlearn.in/board): 6,000+ interactive vocabulary tile puzzles across 7 themed shelves with syllable assembly and English hints.
- [Six Orthodox Darśanas & Philosophy (षड्दर्शनानि)](https://ednetlearn.in/philosophy): Structured exploration of Nyāya, Vaiśeṣika, Sāṅkhya, Yoga, Mīmāṃsā, and Vedānta with computational linguistics and epistemology essays.
- [School Worksheets & Quizzes (अभ्यास-पत्राणि)](https://ednetlearn.in/worksheets): Interactive practice worksheets and chapter quizzes aligned with CBSE and state board Sanskrit curricula.

## Machine Discovery & Metadata

- [Agentic Resource Discovery Catalog](https://ednetlearn.in/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable ARD manifest for WebMCP and autonomous AI agents.
- [Sitemap](https://ednetlearn.in/sitemap.xml): Complete URL index of all learning modules and static routes.
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://ednetlearn.in/llms-full.txt): Detailed textual overview of curriculum, grammar rules, and educational resources.
